title: Flametal mace

infobox.Crafting Materials: Charred bone x15, Flametal x24, Sulfur x9, Asksvin hide x6

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Flametal mace is the sixth Club.
Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its slower secondary attack deals 2.5x damage and 2x staggering.
Like most Ashlands-tier weapons, the Flametal mace can be upgraded to one of the following three variants using gemstones:
• Bloodgeon (Bloodstone)
• Storm Star (Iolite)
• Klossen (Jade)
An upgraded Flametal mace will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.
